header:
How big should your
emergency fund be?

cover.title: How Big Is Your Emergency Fund?

lines.text: A car repair or a lost job shouldn't turn into credit card debt. That's what an emergency fund is for.
lines.say: A car repair or a lost job shouldn't turn into credit card debt. That's what an emergency fund is for.

lines.text: A common goal is three to six months of essential expenses.
lines.say: A common goal is three to six months of essential expenses.

lines.text: If your essentials cost 2,500 a month, that's 7,500 to 15,000 dollars.
lines.say: If your essentials cost twenty-five hundred a month, that's seventy-five hundred to fifteen thousand dollars.

lines.text: That sounds like a lot, so start small. A first goal of 500 dollars covers many surprise bills.
lines.say: That sounds like a lot, so start small. A first goal of five hundred dollars covers many surprise bills.

lines.text: Automate it, keep it in a separate savings account, and only use it for real emergencies.
lines.say: Automate it, keep it in a separate savings account, and only use it for real emergencies.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.
